title: Nvidia loses its founder and a reader reaches for the book — 'A board can govern a vote. It cannot govern a dependence nobody wrote down.'
summary: Jensen Huang resigned on 12 November holding 3.58 percent of Nvidia and no special voting shares, so the board could replace him like any other chief executive. The post sets that against Anthropic's Long-Term Benefit Trust and cites the book for the claim that governance should protect how a company runs rather than who runs it.
attribution_title: Writes on corporate governance and how work gets out of one person's head
blockquote: A board can govern a vote. It cannot govern a dependence nobody wrote down.
